_note: Curated registry. Only contracts whose addresses we verified from the protocol's official docs, cross-checked on-chain. Entries carry the call rules a vault owner approves. recipientWord = index of the ABI argument that must equal the vault (255 = none). Every entry was fork-tested against Monad mainnet (test/AgentVaultDapps.t.sol).

dapps.name: Uniswap v3
dapps.blurb: Swap MON ⇄ USDC via SwapRouter02. Output must go back to the vault, and a minimum output is enforced.

dapps.name: Kintsu
dapps.blurb: Stake MON for sMON. sMON is minted straight to the vault.
